entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Montalvo affair... yes, tragic..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Montalvo affair... yes, tragic. I read about it as well."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But the man was killed by a rogue..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the man was killed by a rogue prison guard. Not our laws."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Watch your words, my nephew. The m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Watch your words, my nephew. The majority of Rizians wish to preserve our traditional values. Does that make them hateful or bigoted?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It does. They must fix their heart..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does. They must fix their hearts or die."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It makes them misguided. Over time..."
entries.dialogueText: "It makes them misguided. Over time, they'll come to accept homosexuality, just as Queen Lyza led them to accept women in the workforce."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They don't really believe that hom..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""No, and your authority as monarch..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, and your authority as monarch has suffered for it. There is a limit to the amount of radical change our kingdom will tolerate."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you sure that's what they want..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure that's what they want? What if they've just been afraid to speak out for all this time?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And how long will they tolerate be..."
entries.dialogueText: "And how long will they tolerate being ruled by a King who views them that way?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your grandmother was a great refor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your grandmother was a great reformer. But even she would not go this far."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And how long will they tolerate be..."
entries.dialogueText: "And how long will they tolerate being ruled by a King who sees their cherished religion as 'brainwashing'?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The repercussions of disregarding..."
entries.dialogueText: "The repercussions of disregarding it will be even worse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want homosexuals in our kingdom..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want homosexuals in our kingdom to live without fear of oppression."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Your authority as monarch is slipping. You're losing the people's respect -- and once that's lost, so is your power over them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'll be honest. If ever there were..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be honest. If ever there were a time to pass this decree, it would be now, while you're still in good standing."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I will be honest. Decriminalizing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be honest. Decriminalizing homosexuality may be seen as 'progress' in foreign circles. But here in Rizia, it will damage your standing beyond repair."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're my Grand Vizier. What do yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're my Grand Vizier. What do you think the repercussions will be?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But as a practicing Wruhecist and..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as a practicing Wruhecist and a member of House Toras, I cannot and will not endorse it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And if passing it leads to your do..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if passing it leads to your downfall, whoever leads Rizia in your stead will surely reverse it. Leaving homosexuals no better off than before."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""So please, think carefully. Is thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "So please, think carefully. Is this truly what you want for the kingdom?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took one more look at the documen..."
entries.dialogueText: I took one more look at the document in front of me.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'll file this away safely for now.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll file this away safely for now."
